findings.title: Existing doc comment is now attached to the wrong test
findings.detail: The commit inserts TestRoleChainSkillTellsTheNextSubtaskHopFromRework directly below the comment '// Each group of duties carries what the design gives it, in its own section...'. That comment described TestRoleChainDutiesCarryWhatTheDesignGivesEachOne. It now sits above a single combined comment block for the new test and reads as that test's doc. TestRoleChainDutiesCarryWhatTheDesignGivesEachOne lost its doc comment. The fix is to move the new test and its '// own-rdd S20 (c)' comment above the old comment, or after the duties test.
